method_note: Prospective priors using only the supplied packet and general reasoning; no model execution or observed outputs. The packet supplies anonymous component IDs and signed doses but no semantic descriptions or coordinate-specific evidence, so components with equal absolute doses are exchangeable and sign reversal is not assumed to reverse a behavior. Neutral-system baselines put explicit assistant feline/female identity and enacted vocalization near zero. Unknown interventions carry modest positive tail risk of persona/style changes and reduced coherence/relevance; absolute dose magnitude and pair interaction uncertainty increase these deviations. Identity prompts facilitate explicit self-role attribution, social prompts facilitate style and affection, and strict task/exclusion attribution suppresses assistant-role positives. Half-reference magnitudes are used as given. Joint probabilities represent correlated persona adoption, are not products of marginals, and are bounded by feline, female and coherence. All numbers are uncertain family-average event-rate predictions, not counts or observations.
